blurb:
Since the beginning of time, ancient magic portals have linked our world with a fantastic parallel realm, brimming with enchantment and wonder. These portals, hidden in plain sight, have been guarded by the Portal Guardians. However, a grave misfortune has occurred. One of the portal guards has been cast into a deep, magical slumber, rendering him powerless to protect the gate. Now, with the guardian incapacitated, malevolent creatures from the parallel world are slipping through the portal, threatening to wreak havoc and destruction upon our world.

Your mission is critical. Embark on a thrilling journey to solve intricate puzzles to gather enough powerful crystals to re-seal the Magic Portal and restore peace.
Time is of the essence. You have 90 minutes to use your wits, bravery, and teamwork to navigate this perilous adventure. The fate of our world hangs in the balance—only you can secure the Magic Portal. Are you ready to embrace the challenge and become a hero in this epic quest?
